extName.message: TreeSide - Vertical Tabs in Chrome's Side Panel
extName.description: Extension name shown in chrome://extensions and the Chrome Web Store listing title.

extDesc.message: Tree-style vertical tabs in Chrome's side panel. Drag to reparent, collapse branches, fuzzy-search tabs. Private by design.
extDesc.description: Extension description shown in chrome://extensions and the Chrome Web Store listing short summary (<=132 chars).

permTabsJustification.message: Reads tab metadata (title, URL, opener, group) to build and update the tree. Powers click-to-focus, middle-click-close, and close-branch. No page DOM reads.
permTabsJustification.description: CWS reviewer justification for the tabs permission.

permTabGroupsJustification.message: Reads and edits Chrome's native tab groups (color, name, membership) so the tree shows group headers and preserves group identity across reparent operations.
permTabGroupsJustification.description: CWS reviewer justification for the tabGroups permission.

permSidePanelJustification.message: Opens the side panel surface. The entire product UI lives in Chrome's native Side Panel.
permSidePanelJustification.description: CWS reviewer justification for the sidePanel permission.

permStorageJustification.message: Persists user preferences, manual reparent overrides, and collapse state in storage.local. No page content. No sync.
permStorageJustification.description: CWS reviewer justification for the storage permission.

treeside_options_about_disclaimer.message: TreeSide is an independent tool. It reads only the tab metadata Chrome already maintains (title, URL, opener relationship, group membership) to draw and manipulate the tree. It never reads page content, never injects scripts, and never makes a network request except when you explicitly enter a license key.
treeside_options_about_disclaimer.description: Independence and privacy disclaimer in the About section.

treeside_onb_eyebrow.description: Brand eyebrow shown at the top of every onboarding page.

treeside_onb_page1_sub.message: TreeSide shows your current window's tabs as a collapsible parent-child tree, built from each tab's opener. No content scripts, no host permissions, no page reads.

treeside_onb_page2_sub.message: Drag any tab onto another to make it a child. Your overrides persist across sessions, so the hierarchy you build stays put.

treeside_onb_page3_sub.message: Subsequence fuzzy-search by title or URL. Collapse branches you don't need right now; they stay collapsed when you come back.

treeside_onb_page4_sub.message: One click closes a tab and all its descendants. Branches with five or more tabs ask for confirmation first.

treeside_onb_page5_sub.message: Free is everything above, forever. Pro adds crash-recovery snapshots, tree templates, custom themes, and keyboard power-tools. One payment; activates forever.
